label: Tehran basin (notional theatre)

urban_bounds.rationale: Central and northern Tehran, ~18 x 17 km, from the city centre up to the Alborz foothills: the densest civilian fabric in the AOI, with the range rising directly behind it. Entirely inside the tehran_basin AOI. Identical to the box the local visual cache was first built for.

regions.name: high range slopes north of the basin
open plain south of the basin

notes: Tehran is a built-in AOI with no protected zones declared. Ambience regions are coarse, hand-drawn open land -- the high range and the southern plain -- far from the urban sub-box; no place, facility or road was consulted.
